name: chat-panel
description: A side panel for the Claude desktop app that lists your Claude Code chats by project, with where each one left off and what it needs from you

projectOrder.title: Project order
projectOrder.description: Project colors, and the order to start with until you move projects in the panel. Example: client-work:#378ADD, personal:#7F77DD

recordsFolder.title: Chat records folder
recordsFolder.description: Only if older chats and search come up empty: the claude-code-sessions folder where the desktop app keeps its chat records
